items.information: Herzlich Willkommen zur ersten Mental Breakdown Competition in Hannover. Wir freuen uns auf einen Tag voller geistiger Höchstleitungen mit euch. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Dieser Wettbewerb ist auf das Blindlösen von Zauberwürfeln und die Disziplin FMC (Lösen in möglichst wenig Zügen) fokussiert. Das "normale" Lösen mit offenen Augen wird bei diesem Wettkampf nicht angeboten. Bitte melde dich nur an, wenn du am Blindlösen und/oder in FMC teilnehmen möchtest. Ansonsten bist du natürlich gerne als Zuschauer willkommen. Welcome to the first Mental Breakdown Competition in Hanover. We look forward to a day full of mental feats with you. **Note for newcomers:** This competition focuses on blind solving of Rubik's cubes and the discipline FMC (solving in as few moves as possible). “Normal” solving with eyes open is not offered in this competition. Please only register if you want to participate in blind solving and/or FMC. Otherwise, you are of course welcome to attend as a spectator. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyMjY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--24c971553ea864bd55df39455e153dcf0c619e1f/Mental.jpg)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg0OTc5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--34df290ff4fde0c20068f1bf6100bcd14e2552f7/e0877ba5-bb31-49b1-b43a-67619e510cab.jpg) # Welcome to **Greenwoods Big Blind and Beyond 2026**! # This competition features **4BLD** as the main event and will take place right after **[FMC World 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCWorld2026)** in the morning. It is also the **first competition in the Philippines to feature two rounds of 4BLD**. The competition includes official events such as **7x7, Clock, 3BLD, and MBLD,** with a focus on big cubes and blindfolded events. **No 3x3 event will be held**, as this competition is designed for specialists in quiet events. Unofficial events include **Master Magic** and **Pyraminx One-Handed**. Please check the **[Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GBBB2026#74010-unofficial-events-info-registration)** tab for more details. This competition marks the third Greenwoods competition of the year, following **[Greenwoods Clock Clash 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsClockClash2026)** and **[Greenwoods Summer Overtime 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GreenwoodsSummerOvertime2026)**, continuing the series of uniquely themed events in the community. We encourage all competitors and guests to review the information tabs for details on the **schedule, regulations, venue guidelines**, and **registration** to help ensure a smooth and well-organized competition. We look forward to seeing you—join us for a day of focused, quiet solving, where blindfolds are on and every solve is all about memory and precision.

items.information: **Special Notice** [**FMC World 2026 - Guangzhou**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCWorld2026) will be held on Sunday, June 21, 2026, from 8:00 to 12:00 in the Meeting Room of Conghua Argyle Hotel (No. 514 Guangcong South Road), Guangzhou. This event is a simultaneous FMC competition for fewest moves enthusiasts worldwide. In addition to the official global top three awards, the Guangzhou Site will present separate awards to its top three competitors. June 21, 2026 coincides with the summer solstice; at noon, the sun will directly shine on the Tropic of Cancer (23°26′N). After the morning fewest moves competition finishes, we cordially invite all competitors to gather at the nearby Guangzhou Tropic of Cancer Park. An award ceremony will be held in front of the Tropic of Cancer Memorial Tower, where competitors will jointly stack a tower column with Rubik's Cubes, witnessing the remarkable phenomenon of "an upright pole casting no shadow." Event page: https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FMC2026 Registration process: First, complete registration via the event page above (WCA account login required). Then, pay the registration fee using Alipay to the Guangzhou Cubing account (gzcubeteam@gmail.com). Upon successful payment, registration will be confirmed. For any questions regarding registration or payment, please contact the organizer via email (same address as above), or search for the WeChat public account "动物魔友会Animal Cubing" and reach out to customer service within the public account. **About the Awards** 1) This competition only has the special-shaped puzzles speed-solving event. In addition to the awards for the top three in each event, awards will also be given to the first place in the competition in the sum of rankings of all events. If there is a tie in the total ranking, the better ranking of Pyraminx will be given priority based on most registration. 2) Competitors must accept any certificates, awards, or prizes in person. Competitors that do not appear in person will forfeit any prizes. 3) The main event of this event is the Pyraminx, and the first place in this event will be announced as the champion of this competition, with the best prizes. **Accompanying Persons and Spectators** To ensure a quiet and orderly competition environment, each competitor may bring a maximum of 1 accompanying person for free admission. Any additional accompanying persons must purchase an admission ticket on-site at the price of ¥50 per person per day. All accompanying persons must register together with the contestant. **Friendly Reminder** This competition does not have any official competitor chat groups. Please be mindful of protecting your personal information and property. If you have any questions, please email the organizers at gzcubeteam@gmail.com, or search for our official account "动物魔友会" (Animal Cubing) on WeChat and contact customer service through the account.

items.information: **Special Notice** [**FMC World 2026 - Guangzhou**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCWorld2026) will be held on Sunday, June 21, 2026, from 8:00 to 12:00 in the Meeting Room of Conghua Argyle Hotel (No. 514 Guangcong South Road), Guangzhou. This event is a simultaneous FMC competition for fewest moves enthusiasts worldwide. In addition to the official global top three awards, the Guangzhou Site will present separate awards to its top three competitors. June 21, 2026 coincides with the summer solstice; at noon, the sun will directly shine on the Tropic of Cancer (23°26′N). After the morning fewest moves competition finishes, we cordially invite all competitors to gather at the nearby Guangzhou Tropic of Cancer Park. An award ceremony will be held in front of the Tropic of Cancer Memorial Tower, where competitors will jointly stack a tower column with Rubik's Cubes, witnessing the remarkable phenomenon of "an upright pole casting no shadow." Event page: https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FMC2026 Registration process: First, complete registration via the event page above (WCA account login required). Then, pay the registration fee using Alipay to the Guangzhou Cubing account (gzcubeteam@gmail.com). Upon successful payment, registration will be confirmed. For any questions regarding registration or payment, please contact the organizer via email (same address as above), or search for the WeChat public account "动物魔友会Animal Cubing" and reach out to customer service within the public account. **About the Competition** Organization Team: Aite Canton Cultural Planning Service Co., Ltd. GZ Cube Team **About the Awards** 1) This competition only has the big cube puzzles speed-solving event. In addition to the awards for the top three in each event, awards will also be given to the first place in the competition in the sum of rankings of all events. If there is a tie in the total ranking, the better ranking of 4x4x4 Cube will be given priority based on most registration. 2) Competitors must accept any certificates, awards, or prizes in person. Competitors that do not appear in person will forfeit any prizes. 3) The main event of this event is the 4x4x4 Cube, and the first place in this event will be announced as the champion of this competition. **Accompanying Persons and Spectators** To ensure a quiet and orderly competition environment, each competitor may bring a maximum of 1 accompanying person for free admission. Any additional accompanying persons must purchase an admission ticket on-site at the price of ¥50 per person per day. All accompanying persons must register together with the contestant. **Friendly Reminder** This competition does not have any official competitor chat groups. Please be mindful of protecting your personal information and property. If you have any questions, please email the organizers at gzcubeteam@gmail.com, or search for our official account "动物魔友会" (Animal Cubing) on WeChat and contact customer service through the account.

items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2026! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF for dere som gir oss beskjed om det. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members who inform us about their membership. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

items.information: **Αυτός ο διαγωνισμός απευθύνεται σε άτομα που συμμετέχουν για πρώτη φορά και σε λιγότερο έμπειρους διαγωνιζόμενους, αλλά όλοι είναι ευπρόσδεκτοι. Παρόλο που ο διαγωνισμός είναι ανοικτός σε όλους, μόνο οι διαγωνιζόμενοι που έχουν συμμετάσχει σε 3 ή λιγότερους διαγωνισμούς στο παρελθόν θα έχουν δικαίωμα για μετάλλια.** **This competition is targeted at first-time participants and less experienced competitors, but everyone is welcome. Even though the competition is open to everyone, only competitors who have participated in 3 or fewer competitions in the past will be eligible for medals.** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTgyNDIyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2a933401125a79a3d07562b86d1bb5f492a5862a/image.png) Ο διαγωνισμός **WCA SUMMER BREAK ATHENS 2026 Β (14/6)** έρχεται για να φέρει το καλοκαίρι… στα πιο γρήγορα solves! 🌞🧊 Πρόκειται για έναν φιλικό και ανοιχτό διαγωνισμό speedcubing στην Αθήνα, σχεδιασμένο με έμφαση στους **αρχάριους**, αλλά χωρίς κανέναν περιορισμό συμμετοχής για όλους τους Cubers. Είτε κάνεις τα πρώτα σου βήματα είτε έχεις ήδη εμπειρία, μπορείς να δηλώσεις συμμετοχή και να ζήσεις την εμπειρία ενός επίσημου WCA διαγωνισμού μέσα σε ένα χαλαρό και υποστηρικτικό περιβάλλον. Η ιδιαιτερότητα του διαγωνισμού είναι ότι **τα podium θα είναι αφιερωμένα στους νέους cubers**. Ετσι, όσοι έχουν ολοκληρώσει έως και 3 επίσημους διαγωνισμούς μέχρι την εγγραφή τους θα διεκδικήσουν τις θέσεις των μεταλλίων. Με αυτό τον τρόπο, δίνεται η ευκαιρία στους αρχάριους να ξεχωρίσουν και να απολαύσουν τη χαρά της διάκρισης, ενώ όλοι οι υπόλοιποι συμμετέχοντες μπορούν να αγωνιστούν κανονικά και να απολαύσουν τη διοργάνωση. **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το **Β μέρος** σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **ΜΟΝΟ σε έναν από τους δύο**. Αγωνίσματα B' διαγωνισμού: * 2x2 * 3x3 * 4x4 * Pyraminx Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **The WCA SUMMER BREAK ATHENS 2026 B (June 14th)** is coming to bring the summer vibes... to the fastest solves! 🌞🧊 This is a friendly and open speedcubing competition in Athens, designed with an emphasis on **beginners**, but without any participation restrictions for any cubers. Whether you are taking your first steps or already have experience, you can register and live the experience of an official WCA competition within a relaxed and supportive environment. The unique feature of this competition is that **the podiums will be dedicated to new cubers**. Specifically, only those who have completed up to 3 official competitions by the time of their registration will be eligible for medals. This gives beginners a chance to stand out and enjoy the thrill of winning, while all other participants can compete as usual and enjoy the event. Note: This competition is **Part B** of a two-competition series. You may participate in **ONLY one of the two**. Competition B events: * 2x2 * 3x3 * 4x4 * Pyraminx Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.name: Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026
items.information: Välkomna till Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026! **Notera att tävlingen hålls i Bergshamra utanför Norrtälje, inte Bergshamra norr om centrala Stockholm!** Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. **OBS:** Grenarna 6x6x6, 7x7x7 och Megaminx kan **inte** kombineras med grenarna 3x3x3 BLD, 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD. Detta innebär att du exempelvis **inte** kan ställa upp i både Megaminx och 3x3x3 BLD, men att du kan ställa upp i både Megaminx och 7x7x7. **OBS:** Maximalt en gäst / medföljande per deltagare på grund av tävlingslokalens storlek. Ingen utomstående publik tillåten. ----- Welcome to Take Your Time Bergshamra 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. **NOTE:** The 6x6x6, 7x7x7 and Megaminx events **can not** be combined with the 3x3x3 BLD, 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD events. This means that, for example, you **can not** enter both Megaminx and 3x3x3 BLD, but you can enter both Megaminx and 7x7x7. **NOTE:** Maximum one guest / accompanying person per competitors due to the size of the competition venue. No external visitors allowed. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY1OTI5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f0650ca58223b353bab20a452b3dca7389995219/CaminosCelaya.jpg) ***🎵"“Tú y las nubes me traen muy loco, Tú y las nubes me van a matar, Yo pa' arriba, volteo muy poco, Tú pa' abajo, no sabes mirar”..."🎶*** El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música. Te esperamos en Celaya para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music. We look forward to seeing you in Celaya to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.name: FMC Canada 2026
items.information: ![(https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) ## FMC Canada 2026 ### [EN] This competition will have competitors simultaneously competing in 3x3x3 Fewest Moves at different locations across Canada with one winner. This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ### [FR] Dans le cadre de cette compétition, des compétiteurs participeront simultanément à l'épreuve du 3x3x3 résolution optimisée à différents endroits au Canada et un seul gagnant sera désigné. Il ne s'agit pas d'une compétition typique où il faut résoudre le plus vite possible, car la seule épreuve est le 3x3x3 résolution optimisée. Il s'agit d'une **épreuve de type examen** au cours de laquelle les compétiteurs passent jusqu'à une heure à trouver la solution la plus courte possible et à **l'écrire sur papier**. Si vous cherchez à participer à une compétition de speedcubing plus classique, merci de chercher [une autre compétition au Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). --- ## Locations / Lieux ### [EN] Please see the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2026#69669-locations-lieux) for more details. ### [FR] Merci de regarder [l'onglet lieux](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2026#69669-locations-lieux) pour plus de détails. --- ## Notice of Filming and Photography / Avis de droit à l'image ### [EN] Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### [FR] Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown I 2026
items.information: Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/). Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Diese Competition richtet sich in erster Linie an erfahrene Speedcuber und ist entsprechend organisiert. Zwar sind Neulinge willkommen, an diesem Turnier nehmen erfahrungsgemäss nur wenige andere Einsteiger teil. Für den ersten Competition-Besuch ist ein einsteigerfreundlicheres Turnier oft die angenehmere Wahl. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup. **Note for newcomers:** This competition is primarily aimed at experienced speedcubers. While newcomers are welcome, there will be only a small number of other beginners attending this event. For a first competition, a more beginner-friendly event is often the more enjoyable choice.

items.information: Willkommen in der ehemaligen Hauptstadt – willkommen in Bonn! Zum allerersten Mal bringt ein Cubing-Turnier die Würfel-Community in diese traditionsreiche Stadt – und wir sind bereit, Geschichte zu schreiben. Freu dich auf ein Wochenende voller Spannung, persönlicher Bestzeiten, packender Finals und unvergesslicher Momente. Ob Newcomer oder Speedcubing-Profi – in Bonn wird gecubed, gefeiert und mitgefiebert! Sei dabei, wenn das erste Turnier in Bonn legendär wird. Melde dich jetzt an – wir können es kaum erwarten, dich dort zu sehen! Welcome to the former capital – welcome to Bonn! For the very first time, a cubing tournament is coming to this historic city – and we’re ready to make history together. Get ready for a weekend full of excitement, personal bests, thrilling finals, and unforgettable moments. Whether you’re a newcomer or a seasoned speedcuber – in Bonn, we cube, we cheer, and we celebrate! Be part of Bonn’s very first tournament and help us make it legendary. Sign up now – we can’t wait to see you there! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYzNzI4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6111d603a3f42ad9b696e4a64eecc2b9664c2245/image.png)

items.name: Franconia Cube Days 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc1ODE1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a5b97380e04dc31adffc60a72bbfc202cab42c5f/FCD.jpg) ###Liebe Speedcuber/innen, Wir laden Euch herzlich zu den Franconia Cube Days 2026 ein. Diese Competition ist der direkte Nachfolger der "Frankfurt Cube Days", die von 2012 bis 2024 stattfanden. Nun sind wir nicht allzu weit umgezogen in die Nähe von Nürnberg, wo wir wieder eine tolle Venue gefunden haben. Wie in der Vergangenheit möchten wir sowohl Anfängern, als auch erfahrenen Cubern eine gute Erfahrung ermöglichen. Die Events 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6 und OH werden im neuen Format "dual rounds" stattfinden, sofern das WCA Softwaresystem dies bis dahin unterstützt. Am Samstag Abend wird es wieder eine After-Comp geben, ganztägig Snacks und Getränke in der Venue und eine Cubing-Börse. Mehr dazu könnt ihr in den Tabs nachlesen. Wir feuen uns auf Euch. ###Dear competitors, Franconia Cube Days 2026 are open to every citizen from every nation. This competition is a direct successor of the "Frankfurt Cube Days" that originated in 2012. The new venue is near Nürnberg, which has good trafic connections by plane, train or car. Our goal is to create a great experience for beginners and advanced cubers aswell. You can stay at our "After-Comp" on saturday evening to have fun and to connect with other cubers. There will be snacks and beverages at the venue and also a cube-swap shop. Please have a look at the tabs for more information. We are looking forward to see you at the FCDs 2026.

items.information: ## Português * O pagamento da inscrição deve ser feito antecipadamente, todas as instruções se encontram na aba de *inscrever-se* do campeonato. * A inscrição **NÃO** será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir. * Alunos e funcionários da FECAP estão isentos da taxa de inscrição ***A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 160 primeiros pagantes. Caso o número de inscritos exceda este limite, será usada uma lista de espera de acordo com a ordem do pagamento.*** **Esta competição tem um limite de inscrições, portanto, caso tenha se inscrito e não possa mais participar, favor informar à equipe de organização, para que a vaga possa ser disponibilizada para outro competidor.** **Utilização de imagem** Há possibilidade de filmagem e fotografias durante a competição, por parte da instituição de ensino ou veículos de mídia autorizados. Ao se inscrever, você concorda que sua imagem pode ser utilizada pela FECAP ou seus parceiros, com fins monetários ou não, sem compensação ou crédito necessário. Ao manter sua inscrição, você também reconhece a leitura e ciência deste aviso -------------------- ## English * The payment of the registration fee must be made in advance. All the relevant instructions can be found under the *register* tab. * The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition. * Students and employees of FECAP will be waived from the registration fee. ***Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 160 payers. If the number of registrations exceeds this limit, a waiting list will be put in place ordered by de date of payment.*** **This competition has a competitor limit, so if you have registered and will no longer be able to attend, please inform the organization team, so the spot can be given to another competitor.** **Image use** It's possible there will be photography and filming at the event, done by FECAP or authorized media outlets. By registering, you agree that your image might be used by FECAP or its partners, for monetary gain or other purposes, without compensation or credit necessary. By keeping your registration, you also recognize to have read and granted permission to this. ![Image description](https://i.postimg.cc/C1vLjXXn/logo-fecap.png)

items.name: Benoni May Madness 2026
items.information: **CubingZA** is excited to announce Benoni May Madness 2026!! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and pay for your ticket to confirm your entry. Please see Registration Requirements below for instructions and when registration opens. We will be having an odd mix of main, side and blind events in this One Day, One Stop, All-Out Total Non-Stop Action-Based Competition so be sure to stick around for all sorts of weird and unique tastes of skill, fortitude and perseverance!! **All New Competitors** If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. **Food and Drinks** Mova Coffee and Sweet N' Sweet will be available from the morning selling food and drinks. They will be around for the duration of the competition so be sure to get your food in between rounds and during lunch because part of being your own champion is competing at your best and not on an empty stomach!!!

items.name: Caminos de Guanajuato - Irapuato 2026

venue.name: [Instituto Irapuato](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Nk8ySpvyGzL9DGRG9)
venue.address: Av Mariano J. García 355, San Miguelito, C.P. 36557 Irapuato, Gto.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyMzAzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fac7617a993cc6636e9f89c013adf99c64048618/CaminosIrapuato.jpg) ##### *🎵"Di que vienes de allá, de un mundo raro, que no sabes llorar, que no entiendes de amor, y que nunca has llorado..."🎶* ## Caminos de Guanajuato – Irapuato 2026 La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** continúa su recorrido y hace escala en **Irapuato, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Este torneo forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo. En cada parada, la música de José Alfredo Jiménez acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a Irapuato. El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música. Te esperamos en Irapuato para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ## Caminos de Guanajuato – Irapuato 2026 The "Caminos de Guanajuato" route continues its journey and makes a stop in **Irapuato, Guanajuato**, a place that reflects the character and cultural richness of our state, where history, tradition, and daily life intertwine in every corner. This tournament is part of a journey that celebrates not only speedcubing but also the cultural identity of our state, connecting different locations under the same competitive and festive spirit. At each stop, the music of José Alfredo Jiménez symbolically accompanies the journey. His songs, which have given voice to the Guanajuato spirit, inspire this edition dedicated to Irapuato. The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music. We look forward to seeing you in Irapuato to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.name: Hessen Open 2026
items.information: Hessen Open 2026 ist eine Zwei-Tages-Competition und Partner-Competition von Hessen Mini Open 2026, die am gleichen Wochenende, freitags, stattfinden wird. Bitte beachte, dass du nur an einem der beiden Wettbewerbe teilnehmen kannst. Wenn du dich für beide Wettbewerbe anmeldest, so zählt nur die erste Anmeldung und wir werden die zweite (spätere) Anmeldung unverzüglich löschen. Hessen Open 2026 is open to every citizen from every nation. Hessen Open 2026 is a two-day competition and series competition to Hessen Mini Open 2026, which will be held at the same weekend, on friday. Please note that you can only compete in one of the two competitions. If you register for both competitions, only the first registration will be valid and we will immediately delete the second (later) registration.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY3NzQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dd29e44056f006464e1550c9f80c639556be0a48/image.png) Dicas: - Este será um evento sem taxas de inscrições, só realize sua inscrição se tiver a certeza que irá comparecer. - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. - Ao se inscrever você está autorizando o uso de imagem para divulgações sobre o campeonato. - Cada competidor pode levar, no máximo, um acompanhante. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! Tips: - This event has no registration fees; only register if you are certain you will attend. - Arrive at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the event you will be participating in; - The cube you will be competing with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, so take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of magic cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organizing team and delegates. - By registering, you are authorizing the use of your image for publicity about the competition. - Each competitor may bring a maximum of one companion. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we always have room for new cubers. Have fun!

items.information: Välkomna till den tredje upplagan av Örebro Side Events! Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. El UPEN Open 2026 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el[ reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ###### English Welcome to UPEN Open 2026, another competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 16, and Sunday, May 17, 2026. UPEN Open 2026 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: ![Speedcubing Austria Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTgyMzE5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--484c13de9df904a57087f1d30b8dae0d69b0c2af/SpeedcubingAustria_Logo_comp_page.png) ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Frühling 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird von Speedcubing Austria sowie von Simon Praschl, Noah Kirrane und Julian Ostadal organisiert und von Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Viktor Kalmar und Fabian Staber delegiert. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Frühling 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Speedcubing Austria as well as Simon Praschl, Noah Kirrane and Julian Ostadal and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Viktor Kalmar and Fabian Staber. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português** **Bem-vindos à segunda competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!!** Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica. Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2026 promete a consolidação do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo consolidar a representatividade também em um Esporte da Mente! Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento! Nos vemos lá! 🇬🇧 **English:** **Welcome to the second speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!!** Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas. Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions. Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport too! Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event! We will meet there!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU5MDQyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4cb58b9882a96f08b772fdbe40b22da459dd42c3/amcm_lateral.png) ### 🇧🇷 Português Campeonato Mineiro 2026, em parceria com a Associação Mineira de Cultura Nipo-Brasileira! Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir. O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$50. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para a modalidade 3x3x3. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ### 🇺🇸 English Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization. Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoMineiro2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin. The registration fee is R$50. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com) Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. Registrations on the spot will be accepted only for the 3x3x3 event. By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 80 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 80 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: 🇧🇷 O Colatina Open 2026 é 3º Campeonato Oficial de Colatina. Estamos ansiosos para recebê-los e queremos compartilhar algumas dicas importantes para os competidores e acompanhantes: - Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA assim que o pagamento for confirmado e o comprovante for enviado. Para mais informações, acesse a aba de [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IIIColatinaOpen2026/register); - Recomendamos chegar ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes do início da modalidade em participará; - Certifique-se de que o cubo que você usará na competição esteja em boas condições, pois cubos danificados podem ser recusados; - Estamos aqui para ajudar! Se você tiver alguma dúvida, fique à vontade para perguntar; - Se este for o seu primeiro campeonato, assista a [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Antes da competição, leia as [Regulamentações da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) para estar familiarizado com as regras; - Divirta-se e aproveite ao máximo! ------------------------------------- 🇺🇸 Colatina Open 2026 is the 3rd Official Colatina Competition. We are excited to welcome you and want to share some essential tips for competitors and companions: - Your registration will be confirmed on the WCA website as soon as the payment is confirmed and the receipt is sent. For more information, visit the [Registration](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IIIColatinaOpen2026/register) tab; - We recommend arriving at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the start of the event you will participate in; - Make sure that the cube you will use in the competition is in good condition, as damaged cubes may not be accepted; - We are here to assist you! If you have any questions, feel free to ask; - If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); - Before the competition, read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) to become familiar with the rules; - Have fun and make the most of the experience!

items.information: # REGISTRO **A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:** * Se estiver participando pela primeira vez, [leia o regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição e aprenda a competir [assistindo o vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU); * Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal; * Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; * Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$25,00 pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato. **Pix renan.cunha20@gmail.com**; * Enviar comprovante de pagamento para o e-mail renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Inscriçoes so serão confirmadas após o envio do comprovante.**; * Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (renan.cunha20@gmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org); * Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, WCA, seus parceiros e apoiadores do campeonato utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. # REGISTRATION **The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:** * If this is your first time competing, [read the WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition and learn how to compete by [watching this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-81VRLyYhbQ); * Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; * There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian; * Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind; * Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$25,00 paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed. **Pix renan.cunha20@gmail.com**; * Send proof of payment to renan.cunha20@gmail.com. **Registrations must be confirmed after sending the voucher.**; * For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (renan.cunha20@gmail.com), or the delegate via email (mcasassa@worldcubeassociation.org); * By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: Jenra Cubing Summer 2026 is an exciting summer speedcubing competition brought to you by Jenra Malls, bringing together cube enthusiasts of all skill levels for a day of fast turns and friendly competition. items.name: Trondheim Spring 2026
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim Spring 2026! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2026/#63531-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim Spring 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2026/#63531-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.name: Vaquita Morelia 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MTU1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--01eacf49bd9968eb69d9a5e57a553918ae411b75/vaquita%20morelia.png) # **VAQUITA MORELIA 2026** **Español** Ven y cubea con nosotros en la hermosa ciudad de la cantera rosada Morelia , Michoacan; un torneo pequeño pero con grandes animos para seguir creciendo nuestra hermosa comunidad. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ **English** Come and enjoy cubing with us in the beautiful pink quarry city of Morelia, Michoacán; a small competition with great enthusiasm to keep growing our wonderful community. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. Come and cube with us in the beautiful city of Morelia, Michoacan, known for its pink quarry stone. It's a small tournament, but with great enthusiasm to continue growing our wonderful community. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: **Deutsch** **Berlin ist Mega!** Wir laden euch herzlich ein zur Westend Mega NxNxN Competition in Berlin, im schönen Bezirk Charlottenburg, Ortsteil Westend. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf euer zahlreiches Erscheinen. Euch erwartet eine schöne Venue direkt an der Stadtautobahn mitten in Berlin, tolle Disziplinen und vor allem großzügige Cutoffs, ein motiviertes Orga-Team und vieles mehr. **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Zeitplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** **English** **Berlin is Mega!** We warmly invite you to the Westend Mega NxNxN Competition in Berlin, in the beautiful Westend part of the district Charlottenburg. We, the organizing team, look forward to seeing you there. You can expect a beautiful venue right next to the city highway in the heart of Berlin, great disciplines, and, above all, generous cutoffs, a motivated organizing team, and much more. **Please read all tabs carefully so you are familiar with the schedule and all modalities.**

items.name: Langenstein City Blind Open 2026

venue.name: Langenstein Stockhalle
venue.details: Follow the signs to the venue

items.information: English version is below Deutsch: Wir freuen uns sehr euch Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer und Thomas Strasser und delegiert von Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber und Jan Křížka. Diesmal findet die Competition in der Eisstockhalle in Langenstein statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! English: We are happy to announce the Langenstein City Blind Open 2026 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Martin Fröhlich, Philipp Leimer and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Pranjal Khan, Fabian Staber and Jan Křížka. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Caminos de Guanajuato - León 2026

venue.name: [Museo de Arte e Historia de Guanajuato](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9SfTK7qDGeZjAWr9A)
venue.address: Prol, C. Calz. de los Heroes 908, La Martinica, 37500 León de los Aldama, Gto.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTYyMjgzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ce5023c17fc9bf649fbe7e7c137c67c69bebbf8b/CaminosLeon.jpg) ##### *🎵"Bonito León, Guanajuato, la feria con su jugada, allí se apuesta la vida y se respeta al que gana..."🎶* ## Caminos de Guanajuato – León 2026 La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** comienza su recorrido en **León, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Este torneo forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo. En cada parada, la música de José Alfredo Jiménez acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a León. El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música. Te esperamos en León para seguir construyendo juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ## Caminos de Guanajuato – León 2026 The "Caminos de Guanajuato" route begins in **León, Guanajuato**, a place that reflects the character and cultural richness of our state, where history, tradition, and daily life intertwine in every corner. This tournament is part of a journey that celebrates not only speedcubing but also the cultural identity of our state, connecting different locations under the same competitive and festive spirit. At each stop, the music of José Alfredo Jiménez symbolically accompanies the journey. His songs, which have given voice to the Guanajuato spirit, inspire this edition dedicated to León. The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music. We look forward to seeing you in León to continue building the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the[ WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

This competition has reached its 180 competitor limit, and has a long waiting list. Therefore, registration has closed early.** If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Mise à jour du 14 mars. Cette compétition a atteint sa limite de 180 compétiteurs et dispose d'une longue liste d'attente. Les inscriptions ont donc été clôturées plus tôt que prévu.** Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LH3QG7krdgc). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc). ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans le cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. follow them on socials by scanning the QR Code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bea620be86f2f2e79b7ff56af3eef8d900240518/IMG_2596.jpg) The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** have gracouisly offered us the venue at a very reduced rate as part of their support for the competition. Please continue to return the favour to them by supporting their restaurant and accomodation. Also follow the hotel on socials by scanning the QR code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--781305c69b42fd5cad23e5a76d3b2c4c6e2cd2f3/IMG_2595.jpg) ##Accommodation The hotel have offered discounted accommodation rates to our cubers (and guests) for the weekend of the competition. You can book your accomodation by sending an email to Penny Mbobo pmbobo@legacyhotels.co.za and mention the code "Rubiks 2026" when making your booking. Reach out to the competition organizers or delegates if you have more questions. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: ### Português **Atencão:** Chegamos ao limite de inscrições, isso significa que novas inscrições serão aceitas **somente caso haja alguma desistência**. Neste caso, entraremos em contato com todos os inscritos não confirmados via e-mail, daremos um período para que respondam manifestando interesse, e aprovaremos as inscrições pela ordem que foram feitas, mediante pagamento da taxa de inscrição (R$20). Esta competição possui **limite de inscrições**, em caso de desistência, **entre em contato com a organização ([fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org))** para que a vaga possa ser disponibilizada para outra pessoa. #### Utilização de imagem Há possibilidade de filmagem e fotografias durante a competição, por parte do shopping ou veículos de mídia autorizados. Ao se inscrever, você concorda que sua imagem pode ser utilizada pelo shopping ou seus parceiros, com fins monetários ou não, sem compensação ou crédito necessário. Ao manter sua inscrição, você também reconhece a leitura e ciência deste aviso. ### English: **Attention:** We have reached the competitor limit, which means that new registrations will only be accepted **if there is a cancellation**. In that case, we'll reach out to all not confirmed registered competitors through email. We'll give a time window answer, saying they're still interested in participating, and we'll approve the registrations in the order they happened, after paying the registration fee (R$20). This competition has a **competitor limit**, in case of withdrawal, **contact the organization team ([fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:fcardim@worldcubeassociation.org))** so your spot can be given to someone else. #### Image use It's possible there will be photography and filming at the event, done by the mall or authorized media outlets. By registering, you agree that your image might be used by the shopping mall or its partners, for monetary gain or other purposes, without compensation or credit necessary. By keeping your registration, you also recognize to have read and granted permission to this.

The organizers of this competition will have to submit a list of all visitors (which includes the competitor and their adult chaperone if the competitor is a minor) to the NYU visitor system after registration has been finalized. If you would like to bring additional guests, please reach out to the organizers and we will let you know if there are any extra guest slots. ​ **NYU Students and Alumni:** NYU students and alumni will receive a full refund for their registration. Please provide your NYU email in the comments of your registration and a full refund will be initiated once your registration is accepted.

items.name: Beginner & Blind Benoni 2026
items.information: **CubingZA** is excited to announce Beginner & Blind Benoni 2026!! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and pay for your ticket to confirm your entry. Please see Registration Requirements below for instructions and when registration opens. We will be having the Beginner Events in the morning and Blindfolded Events in the afternoon. There will be a separate Awards' Ceremony after each one so if you can, feel free to stick around for both and witness Total Non-Stop Action...with your eyes open or closed!! **All New Competitors** If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY1MDYzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ccd65f403457dc282c8579d38ca9bea44c3a8e26/636674475_1225483876408329_1643318046908654871_n.jpg) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Β μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Τα events 3x3 και 2x2 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα Skewb, Clock, Blind ή 4x4, Pyraminx επιθυμείτε. Μετά τη μεγάλη επιτυχία του πρώτου διαγωνισμού του 2026 που έγινε για πρώτη φορά στο Panellinios Club House, η λαϊκή απαίτηση ήταν να επαναληφθεί ένας διαγωνισμός σύντομα στο ίδιο μέρος! Ελάτε με τους κύβους σας να περάσουμε όμορφες στιγμές με το αγαπημένο μας χόμπι. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Easter Fever Athens Β 2026.** Αγωνίσματα Β' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 2x2 * 4x4 * Pyraminx Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **Attention:** This competition is Part B of a series of two competitions. You may participate in **only one of the two.** The 3x3 and 2x2 events are included in both competitions, so choose carefully which day or which of the Skewb, Clock, Blind or 4x4, Pyraminx you would like to compete in. After the great success of the first 2026 competition, which was held for the first time at the Panellinios Club House, popular demand called for another competition to be organized soon at the same venue! Bring your cubes and join us to enjoy great moments with our favorite hobby. We look forward to seeing you at **Easter Fever Athens B 2026.** Events of Competition B: * 3x3 * 2x2 * 4x4 * Pyraminx Please read the following pages carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered complete, you must complete the registration on the competition’s WCA page **AND** pay the participation fee using your bank card through the Stripe payment platform used by the WCA, as described in the adjacent tabs.

items.information: **Note:** Competitors under the age of 18 must fill out this [form](https://forms.gle/cFt7i8vmK9yEA7U2A) and be accompanied by an adult parent/guardian at all times. Join us for a short competition on the same day as [CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2026)! This competition will **not** hold the 3x3x3 speedsolving event, but it is a great way to achieve qualifying times for the Southeast and North American Championship or get some extra solves in for less commonly held events. Southeast FMC Championship will be held from 10AM-2PM at the same location; if you are not competing in FMC, you are not obligated to stay at the competition during those hours. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY1MDU4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--343fb48d95ff550aed6f6227869a36bc2067a416/636674475_1225483876408329_1643318046908654871_n.jpg) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Α μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Τα events 3x3 και 2x2 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα Skewb, Clock, Blind ή 4x4, Pyraminx επιθυμείτε. Μετά τη μεγάλη επιτυχία του πρώτου διαγωνισμού του 2026 που έγινε για πρώτη φορά στο Panellinios Club House, η λαϊκή απαίτηση ήταν να επαναληφθεί ένας διαγωνισμός σύντομα στο ίδιο μέρος! Ελάτε με τους κύβους σας να περάσουμε όμορφες στιγμές με το αγαπημένο μας χόμπι. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Easter Fever A 2026.** Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 2x2 * Skewb * Clock * Blind Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **Attention:** This competition is Part A of a series of two competitions.
